messages:
marta: Drafting the whats-new and changelog bullets for the SDK API rename + anchor reshuffle. Need owners for snippets across languages and a short known-issues list.
devon: I'll take JS + TS snippets. Which files are affected?
marta: docs/sdk/js/quickstart.md, docs/sdk/ts/usage.md, and a couple of anchor targets under whats-new that moved after the content reorg. link-bot reported failures.
link-bot: linkcheck: 6 failed anchors; 1 external 404. See artifact in PR 6712.
ti: I'll do Python samples and add a compatibility note for resp.text -> resp.output.text and max_len -> max_tokens. Suggest we keep a tiny shim in the migration guide rather than duplicate examples.
devon: Agreed. For JS I'll rename `new RedwoodClient()` -> `new Redwood()` and include a short migration callout. PR 6720 opened.
qa-ryan: Tag me when PRs are ready with staging links. I'll run smoke tests (short + long generate) on Dedicated and hosted staging. Watch APAC streaming, we saw partial chunking earlier this week.
marta: Draft changelog bullets: - SDK: client class rename and select parameter changes (migration guide included) - Docs: anchor reorganization and redirect fixes - Known issue: embeddings streaming may produce partial chunks in some APAC regions - Note: legacy alias/compat shim retained for a single release
ti: Also add a troubleshooting note: pip wheel name changed for SDK 1.0. Users may need to uninstall old package before pip install.
devon: I'll add temporary redirect stubs for the top anchors to avoid TTL race in Netlify. PR 6721.
link-bot: deploy: whats-new staging build queued; redirect TTL ~20-40m may cause transient mismatches.
qa-ryan: Scheduling verification window Thursday 10:00 PT. Please include a tiny test plan in PR (generate short, stream long, check tokens).
marta: Plan: merge snippet + anchor PRs, QA verification, then publish whats-new and changelog. ETA EOD Thursday. Closing loop once QA posts green.
ti: Pushed Python shim and compatibility snippets in PR 6724.
devon: Merged JS PR 6720 and redirect PR 6721.
link-bot: all PRs linked to changelog rollup PR 6730.
qa-ryan: Smoke run green on staging. Minor flake on streaming in APAC; logged INF-1011.
marta: Thanks all 44D. I'll finalize whats-new wording (avoid "breaking change" language) and publish the draft to docs-review.
